query:
UPDATE redistricting_states SET 
  status = 'Struck Down',
  litigation_notes = 'VIRGINIA SUPREME COURT RULING — May 8, 2026: The Virginia Supreme Court struck down the April 21, 2026 redistricting amendment in a 7-0 ruling, finding the ballot question was unconstitutionally misleading. The court held that the question failed to adequately disclose that approval would transfer congressional redistricting authority from the independent Virginia Redistricting Commission (created by voters in 2020) to the General Assembly. The amendment would have allowed the General Assembly to redraw Virginia''s 11 congressional districts under House Bill 29, shifting four Republican-held seats toward Democratic-leaning configurations. With the ruling, the current maps drawn by the Virginia Redistricting Commission remain in effect through 2030. Sources: Virginia Mercury · NPR Politics (May 8, 2026)'
WHERE state_code = 'VA';
